adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `accessTokenParsed` comes from `parseRefreshTokenResponse(accessTokenJson, salesforceTokenSchema)`. The helper in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts` throws when `safeParse` fails (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.success) throw new Error(...)`) and otherwise returns the `safeParse` result, which necessarily has `success: true`. Therefore `if (!accessTokenParsed.success)` is dead/unreachable code. However, the diff does not show any concrete broken behavior beyond this contract mismatch/dead branch; the thrown error still rejects the async function similarly to the explicit `Promise.reject` path.
